trajectory_cp.law: frozen RGB image replay; IID initial state and fixed-per-episode appearance

safety_scope: Numerical robust SBC for the stopped AEBS model conditional on the observation tube. CP is trajectory-marginal for the fixed registered replay law only; no new-image, real-vehicle, arrival or formal floating-point guarantee.
probability_scope: If the deterministic audit is sound, covered trajectories are safe; selection-safe P(audit accepted AND unsafe new registered-law trajectory)<=0.05. Not P(unsafe|audit accepted)<=0.05.
